reply.text: This is a change to your program, so I'll make it happen through the app. Let me pull up your current plan first so I know what we're working with. The program lookup came back empty, so I can't see a current plan to restructure. That usually means there's no active program on your account yet, or it isn't set up in a form I can read. Once you have a program running, tell me and we'll look at how to fit it into four days. If you want a new 4-day build instead, I can build it for you from scratch with the Build it option, and I'd want to know what you're training for and what equipment you have.
